ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels in the central lobe areas and 35% low-intensity black pixels along the trailing edge and median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude linear regularity; right trailing edge is similar until the distal tip, which exhibits a high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serration pattern.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal dark linear mark approximately 35 pixels in length on the inner-mid region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and potential amputation/trauma at the extreme right fluke tip; linear rake mark on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Concentrated region of small high-contrast black spots on the lower-inner portion of the left fluke lobe.
